detectors.name: TouchFC v1 (RF-DETR-S)
detectors.note: Own model: RF-DETR-Small (Apache 2.0) on CC BY data, 512 px. Slots 1 ball, 3 referee, 4 player checked on the test clips; 2 assumed goalkeeper; 5-8 unused. The ONNX class_names metadata is the stale COCO list.
